## Summary

Describe the problem and the implemented change.

## Design and tradeoffs

Explain important decisions, security boundaries, and alternatives considered.

## Verification

- [ ] Backend tests pass
- [ ] Evaluation passes or expected metric changes are explained
- [ ] Frontend production build passes
- [ ] Relevant Playwright tests pass
- [ ] Database changes include an Alembic migration
- [ ] Authorization changes include negative tests
- [ ] No secrets, real telemetry, personal information, or generated reports are included

## Screenshots or operational evidence

Include UI screenshots, metrics, query plans, or logs when they materially help review.
